meta.title: Buka Workers
meta.description: Manage workers in the sidebar: every worker has an immutable identifier (id) used as the directory name and reference key, plus an optional display name; agents have a directory, AGENTS.md and project skills, while robots are fixed programs (v1 ships clock); a workflow names an agent to handle a human task or receive the final report on a person's behalf (an assistant is not a marker on a worker), and each agent can pick the model for its new sessions. The registry is version 4 (id / name / driver), data from older registries is migrated automatically (the old name becomes the id), renaming only changes the display name; deleting is a hard delete (registry entry, directory and workspace registration together) blocked only by running jobs that reference the identifier, while workflows and jobs that still reference a deleted worker derive an "unavailable" state.
